paper_title: Das Dilemma der Speicherverpflichtung im Gasmarkt: Optimiertes Marktdesign erforderlich
caption: Entwicklung des THE Sommer-Winter-Spreads seit April 2024
model_annotation: The diagram illustrates the development of the THE summer-winter spread from April 2024 to February 2025, representing the difference in Euro per megawatt-hour (MWh). The x-axis is labeled with months from April 2024 to February 2025, with a linear scale and regular tick labels at monthly intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Euro/MWh" and ranges from -7 to 3, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 1. A single blue line is plotted on the graph, starting at approximately 1.8 Euro/MWh in April 2024 and fluctuating between 1 and 2.5 Euro/MWh until October 2024, with a peak of around 2.2 Euro/MWh in July 2024; it then drops sharply to around -3.8 Euro/MWh in November 2024, followed by fluctuations between -1 and -4 Euro/MWh until January 2025, ending at around -5.5 Euro/MWh in February 2025, with a notable spike to around -2 Euro/MWh at the very end of the graph.
